-- For Der Helle Kumpel (6520): total_inv=400, total_demand=300, so all orders fulfilled = 100% ✓

-- insufficient inventory to fulfill all orders.

-- But wait - the question mentions "smallest available quantity" as part of the FIFO criteria.
-- I'm currently only using earliest purchase date, not considering smallest quantity within 
-- the same purchase date. Let me check if this matters.

-- Actually, looking at the inventory data more carefully, for some products there are multiple
-- inventory slots from the same purchase date with different quantities. The FIFO approach 
-- should pick from the same purchase date but smallest quantity first.

-- Let me verify my ranking is correct. For product 4280:
SELECT i.product_id, p.name, p2.purchased, i.qty, 
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p2.purchased, i.qty, i.id) as fifo_rank
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN purchases p2 ON i.purchase_id = p2.id
WHERE i.product_id = 4280
ORDER BY fifo_rank
